# Ringkøbing-Skjern

Ringkøbing-Skjern is a Danish municipality (kommune) that appears in the AFDK-programme documentation as part of the "Sundhedsklynge Kommune Ringkøbing-Skjern" — a healthcare cluster grouping for the municipality [^src1]. It is mentioned once, in a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Structured Patient Education) for atrial fibrillation care in Denmark, which includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters (sundhedsklynger) participating in the AFDK programme (Atrieflimren i Danmark), a programme administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram. No further details, relationships, or claims about the municipality are available in the corpus.
